body:
Refreshed artifact release superseding `artifacts-v1` (2026-10-08, pre-refresh). Updated 2026-10-13: `raw_data.tar.gz` repackaged (it no longer ships `data/raw/sha256sums.txt` — see verification below) and `processed_cache.tar.gz` added so the README fast path runs end to end.

## Contents
- `raw_data.tar.gz` — the 10 raw CSVs of `data/raw/` under the `data/raw/` prefix, plus `document_years.csv`. The 8 ChEMBL pulls carry `standard_relation` (plus `data_validity_comment` and `activity_id`); **BACE and ESOL never have a relation column** — `02_clean_data.py` skips the censoring filter only for those non-ChEMBL sources.
- `processed_cache.tar.gz` — `data/processed/*_fingerprints.npz` (8 ChEMBL tags + BACE), the featurization cache `gnn_01_make_splits.py` needs on a fresh clone.
- `models.tar.xz` — 26 RF models from the 2026-10-12 release state: 18 random/scaffold models and 8 **historical, pre-as-of temporal models**, under the `models/` prefix. The temporal models do not match the later as-of labels and retrained results in PR #7.
- `sha256sums.txt` — sha256 of the three archives (download-integrity manifest).

## Verification
- `scripts/fetch_artifacts.py` reads the repo's **tracked** `data/raw/sha256sums.txt` into memory *before* extracting anything, verifies the raw files in a temp dir against it, and **refuses any archive that contains a `data/raw/sha256sums.txt` member** (the trust anchor can never be overwritten by a release). Cache is bucketed per release tag under `.artifacts_cache/<tag>/`.
- These assets support the random/scaffold fast path. They do not reproduce the later as-of temporal models in PR #7. On `main` since PR #7 was merged, `scripts/fetch_artifacts.py` installs only the 18 random/scaffold RF models and preserves existing time models; the 8 historical time models in this archive are deliberately skipped. Use the committed `restore_time_inputs.py` and the PR campaign records for the temporal analysis.
- The `egfr` raw file is the 2026-10-11 re-pull (8,000 data rows, commit `e37c572`), not the pre-refresh 8,936-row pull shipped in artifacts-v1.

Built 2026-10-12 from `fix/review-2026-10-11` (tag `data-refresh-2026-10-11` state); assets refreshed 2026-10-13 per PR #5 review.

## Temporal model clarification (2026-10-14)

The as-of temporal retraining and follow-up review fixes were merged through [PR #7](https://github.com/LessRAY3-3/qsar-activity-prediction/pull/7). This note changes documentation only: no archive or checksum has been replaced. The new RF temporal joblibs are not distributed by this release. PR #7 was merged into `main` at commit `75953818f863e4b2f4e7d2fd609755234ce2e2ef`; the fetcher protection described above is available there.
